name: reader: nested lists are cards again
why: The outermost-list guard is gone: every nested list of the script becomes a links card named after its h2.

name: reader: the search lists are not recognised
why: _SB_SEARCH_LIST_SEL matches nothing: the script's lists are read as plain link lists.

name: reader: the Search group goes last
why: The group is pushed after every links group instead of where the sidebar has it.

name: reader: an item's whole text is its detail again
why: _sbOwnText() keeps every child element's text: the script's 'edit' and 'choose languages en: …' are back on the chips.

edits.find:
!n.matches('ul, ol, a, h3, h4, .icon, .mb-sb-count, .mb-sb-h3-icon, .mb-toggle-icon') &&
                     !n.querySelector('a, ul, ol')) s += ' ' + n.textContent;

name: chips: no child links
why: _sbLinkChip() leaves out row.kids: Wikidata loses its '› en' link.

name: tables: nested links not in Details
why: Details keep only the own text.

name: index: variants not merged
why: _sbMergeVariants() returns every link as its own entry.

name: index: empty sections not recorded
why: The walk records no empty section or group: the foot line is empty.

edits.find:
if (!r.n && label) inner.push({ source, path: p });
                    else inner.push(...r.empty);

name: switch: ignored
why: _sbSearchApply() shows every heading whatever the switch says.

edits.find: if (scope && part.dataset.mbSbSource !== scope) { part.hidden = true; return; }

name: find: Esc does nothing
why: The find box's Esc branch is gone. Recorded as pass: the box is an input type=search, and Chromium empties it on Esc by itself and fires input, so the spec still sees an empty box, the full count and an open card. The branch stays for browsers that do not, and to stop Esc at the box.

name: card: starts open
why: The Search card ignores the start-open setting.

name: layout: no split
why: _sbInlineLayout() always builds the old wrapping row.

name: layout: never stacks
why: The container query is gone: facts and links stay side by side at any width.

name: hover: the forwarding page is named, not the site
hover stack: the link's card is not in the preview's stack
why: _dpCollectNotes() leaves out the link's data-mbtt card.

edits.find: if (own && own.dataset && own.dataset.mbtt) notes.push({ kind: 'tip', html: own.dataset.mbtt });

name: hover stack: a data-mbtt card does not give way
why: yieldTo() hides only an own (title) card again: the link's card stays beside the preview.

name: hover stack: coming back onto the link shows a second box
why: The mouseover guard for a link whose preview shows is gone.
